answers.explanation: A rare term is telling; a common one says little.
BM25's b parameter controls how much to penalize long documents.
With TF-IDF, repeating a keyword 100 times scores 100 times higher, which spammers exploit.
b = 1 normalizes fully; the usual default is 0.75.
Cheap first-pass retrieval, expensive second-pass reranking.
WAND and block-max WAND go further by skipping documents that can't beat the current kth score.
